notes.title: Walk booking API
notes.body:
Add `POST /walks` so owners can book a walk.

- validate the time slot
- reject double bookings
- return the walker's name

notes.title: Map view of nearby walkers
notes.body: Show walkers within 2 km on a map. Tapping a pin opens their profile.

notes.title: Dark mode for the booking screen
notes.body: The booking screen ignores the system theme. Match the rest of the app.

notes.title: Export walk history as CSV
notes.body: Owners want a spreadsheet of past walks for their records.

notes.title: Walker badges
notes.body: Small badges for 100 walks, 5-star streaks and so on. Nice to have.

notes.title: Release checklist
notes.body:
1. Bump the version
2. Run the build workflow
3. Smoke test login on a phone
4. Announce in the changelog

notes.title: Color ideas
notes.body: Warm red accent, off-white surfaces, **one** highlight color only.

notes.title: Interview notes: dog owners
notes.body:
- most book walks the night before
- price matters less than trust
- want photos during the walk

notes.title: Copy tone
notes.body: Short sentences. No jargon. Talk to one person, not "users".

notes.title: Devices to test on
notes.body: Small Android phone, iPhone SE, a tablet in landscape, and a TV browser.
